seoTitle: SpongeBob Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the SpongeBob test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, Mr. Krabs, Sandy, Plankton, Mrs. Puff or Pearl — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the endless optimist, the grumpy artist, or the tiny schemer with a giant plan? Answer 11 everyday questions about work, friends and days off, and find out which SpongeBob character you are.

characters.name: SpongeBob
characters.title: The Optimist
characters.summary: Cheerful, enthusiastic and endlessly positive. You love your friends, you love your job, and you love every single day.
description: Like SpongeBob, you're relentlessly optimistic. He's enthusiastic about his job and his friends.
You love what you do. SpongeBob is the fry cook at the Krusty Krab.
You've got your own style. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple under the sea.
characters.flaw: You're so enthusiastic that you can wear people out.
characters.signature: A big grin, a spatula and a never-ending supply of enthusiasm.
characters.clashReason: they'd be cheerful at you when you just want some peace

characters.name: Patrick Star
characters.title: The Best Friend
characters.summary: Laid-back, loyal and easy to please. You don't overthink anything, and you're always up for hanging out.
description: Like Patrick, you're a loyal best friend. He's SpongeBob's best friend.
You keep life simple. Patrick lives under a rock.
You don't sweat the small stuff. Patrick is usually unemployed, and perfectly happy about it.
characters.flaw: You'd rather nap than think about anything too hard.
characters.signature: A big smile, a comfy rock and absolutely no plans.
characters.clashReason: they'd forget what you asked them to do, instantly

characters.name: Squidward
characters.title: The Grump
characters.summary: Artistic, sophisticated and deeply unimpressed. You believe you were meant for better things, and you'd like some peace and quiet, please.
description: Like Squidward, you're a misunderstood artist. He sees himself as a gifted artist and musician.
You're not a fan of your job. Squidward is the cashier at the Krusty Krab, and he despises working there.
You want more from life. Squidward dreams of a much better life.
characters.flaw: You complain so much that people stop listening.
characters.signature: A sigh, a half-finished painting and a strong wish to be left alone.
characters.clashReason: they'd sigh loudly every time you spoke

characters.name: Mr. Krabs
characters.title: The Boss
characters.summary: Cunning, hard-working and very careful with money. You run a tight ship, and you love your family.
description: Like Mr. Krabs, you know the value of a penny. He's obsessed with money.
You're the boss. Mr. Krabs owns the Krusty Krab.
You've got a soft spot. Mr. Krabs loves his daughter, Pearl.
characters.flaw: You'll pinch a penny even when you really shouldn't.
characters.signature: A cash register, a sharp eye and a secret recipe locked away.
characters.clashReason: they'd charge you for the advice they just gave you

characters.name: Sandy Cheeks
characters.title: The Scientist
characters.summary: Smart, adventurous and fearless. You love science, sport and a challenge, and you're not one to back down.
description: Like Sandy, you're brilliant. She's a scientist squirrel from Texas.
You love a challenge. Sandy is into extreme sports and karate.
You make it work, wherever you are. Sandy lives under the sea in a glass dome, and wears a diving suit to breathe.
characters.flaw: You can't resist a challenge, even when you really should.
characters.signature: A diving helmet, a karate chop and a big Texas grin.
characters.clashReason: they'd challenge you to a contest, and win

characters.name: Plankton
characters.title: The Schemer
characters.summary: Ambitious, determined and always plotting. You never give up on a plan, even when it fails for the hundredth time.
description: Like Plankton, you've always got a scheme. He's always trying to steal the Krabby Patty secret formula.
You don't give up. Plankton runs the Chum Bucket, and keeps going even though it fails.
You've got backup. Plankton's wife, Karen, is a supercomputer who's often behind his plans.
characters.flaw: You want to win so badly that you never enjoy anything.
characters.signature: An evil laugh, a big plan and a backup plan for the backup plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd see you as part of their next scheme

characters.name: Mrs. Puff
characters.title: The Worrier
characters.summary: Kind, patient and very easily stressed. You try your best, but life keeps giving you reasons to panic.
description: Like Mrs. Puff, you're a bit of a worrier. She's a paranoid pufferfish who puffs up when she's scared.
You're patient with people. Mrs. Puff is SpongeBob's boating-school teacher.
You've had a rough time. Mrs. Puff is often arrested because of SpongeBob's terrible driving.
characters.flaw: You panic at the first sign of trouble.
characters.signature: A nervous smile, a deep breath and a very stressful day.
characters.clashReason: they'd panic about something you weren't even worried about

characters.name: Pearl
characters.title: The Teen
characters.summary: Stylish, dramatic and desperate to fit in. You know what's cool, and you'll make sure everyone knows it.
description: Like Pearl, you want to fit in. She's Mr. Krabs' teenage daughter.
You know what's in. Pearl loves shopping and pop music.
You stand out, whether you like it or not. Pearl is a sperm whale, and much bigger than all of her friends.
characters.flaw: You care a little too much about what everyone else thinks.
characters.signature: A shopping bag, a pop song and a very dramatic sigh.
characters.clashReason: they'd be embarrassed to be seen with you

questions.text: It's Monday morning, and it's time for work. You...

options.text: Jump out of bed. You love your job!
Groan, and count the hours until home time
Roll over. You don't have a job anyway
Get in early, and make sure everyone else is on time

questions.text: A whole free day is yours. You fill it with...

options.text: Practising your music, with nobody bothering you
Karate, then an extreme sport, then a science experiment
Shopping with your friends, all afternoon
Lying perfectly still, doing absolutely nothing

questions.text: You find some money on the floor. You...

options.text: Pocket it, and check for more
Hand it in straight away
Use it to fund your next big plan
Spend it on something cute, immediately

questions.text: You're taking your driving test. You...

options.text: Ace the written part, then crash the car
Feel so nervous you can barely breathe
Pass first time, no problem
Forget which one is the brake

questions.text: Someone at work is way too cheerful. You...

options.text: Shut your door, and wait for it to stop
Wish you could be that relaxed
Don't mind, as long as they're working
Find it suspicious. What are they up to?
Swear revenge, and start a new plan immediately
Work out what went wrong, scientifically
Cry dramatically, then call your friends
Lie down. You need a minute

questions.text: Your friends invite you to a party. You...

options.text: Spend three hours deciding what to wear
Go, and fall asleep on the sofa
Stay home. Parties are beneath you
Arrive first, and help set everything up

questions.text: A neighbour asks you for a small loan. You...

options.text: Charge interest. Obviously
Give them whatever's in your pockets
Lend it, then worry about it constantly
Ask what they'll give you in return

questions.text: Someone challenges you to a contest. You...

options.text: Accept. You've never lost
Accept, then quietly bend the rules
Agree, then lose on purpose so it ends faster
Only if it's a dance contest

questions.text: You run a restaurant with a top-secret recipe, and your rival keeps trying to steal it. You...

options.text: Hire a guard, as long as they're cheap
Defend it, proudly, with a spatula
Panic, and tell someone you really shouldn't have
Ask if you can taste it first

questions.text: You're tiny, and everyone underestimates you. You...

options.text: Build a giant robot, and show them
Wish you could just blend in
Prove them wrong with your brains
Remind everyone you're a misunderstood genius
